title: Watch: What happens now after close vote in Israeli election?
originalTitle: Watch: What happens now after close vote in Israeli election?
content:
Polls have closed in the Israeli election and votes are being counted.

Exit polls suggest there is no clear winner, with neither veteran Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor former military chief Gadi Eisenkot on track to secure a majority.

The BBC's Hugo Bachega looks at what might happen next.

Read more on this story.
